sections.title: Who we are
paragraphs: Creadent Dental Clinic is a Kolkata-based dental care practice built around clear communication, reliable treatment planning, and a comfortable patient experience.
We aim to combine professional clinical care with a calm, well-organized process so patients can make informed decisions with confidence.

sections.title: What matters to us
items: Clear guidance before, during, and after treatment
A welcoming experience for children, adults, and senior patients
Practical treatment recommendations based on actual patient needs
Consistent follow-up and support for long-term oral health

sections.title: Our approach
paragraphs: We believe dental care should feel approachable and transparent. That means explaining treatment options in simple terms, discussing expected outcomes honestly, and respecting each patient's time and comfort.
Whether you are visiting for preventive care or a more advanced procedure, our goal is to deliver dependable care through a thoughtful and organized clinical experience.

sections.title: General refund guidance
paragraphs: Refund requests are reviewed based on the nature of the payment, the service status, and the circumstances of the request.
Any approved refund is processed using the original payment method wherever operationally possible.

sections.title: When a refund may be considered
items: Duplicate or accidental payment transactions
Payments collected for a service that was not ultimately provided
Other exceptional situations reviewed by the clinic on a case-by-case basis

sections.title: When a refund may not apply
items: Completed consultations, procedures, or services already delivered
Charges already consumed toward diagnostic, administrative, or treatment-related work
Situations where non-refundable terms were shared in advance

sections.title: Processing time
paragraphs: Approved refunds may take reasonable processing time depending on the payment provider, banking channels, and verification requirements.
For assistance, please contact the clinic with your payment details and request summary.

sections.title: Appointment cancellation
paragraphs: If you need to cancel or reschedule an appointment, please contact the clinic as early as possible so the slot can be managed appropriately.
Advance notice helps us support other patients and coordinate clinic schedules more effectively.

sections.title: Late cancellation or missed visits
items: Repeated short-notice cancellations may affect future scheduling preference
Missed appointments without prior notice may require reconfirmation before a new booking is accepted
Prepaid bookings may be reviewed in line with our refund policy and treatment-specific terms

sections.title: Rescheduling support
items: Our team will make reasonable efforts to provide the next suitable appointment slot
Rescheduled timing depends on doctor availability, treatment requirements, and clinic operations
Urgent dental concerns should be communicated clearly while requesting a new slot

cta.description: Get in touch with the clinic directly and the team will guide you through the next available option.
